method: static source review of every executor/provider/harness module (main audit)
independent second-opinion source audit (executor-state-leak-audit-independent.json, 68 files, 14 findings)

offline byte-exact request reconstruction: 30 tuples across V2.2/V2.4/V3-R1 re-rendered with the frozen executor builders; serialized_request_sha256 matched stored run hashes 22/22 (all rows with stored shas)
cross-check: independent re-render of A3/tt15-006 produced identical sha 03b12ee6100231e3... (matches main reconstruction)

main_findings.description: Request body is a pure function of (modelId, system, user, maxOutputTokens, confirmedParams); field order fixed; no tuple_index, attempt, run-progress, clock, or counter field exists in the body.
buildArmContext derives current/evidence/route deterministically from the fixture + frozen harness modules; no fixture mutation; retries re-render byte-identical bodies.
AbortController + timeout timer created fresh per provider.call; fetch uses global undici; no connection/session/keep-alive state managed by the executor.

Retry classification is content-free: based only on error code/meta; EMPTY_CONTENT with finish_reason=length/content_filter fails closed; no tuple-index or sample-specific branches; no literal 711/tt15/A3 anywhere.
The only tuple-identity-dependent runtime behavior is the frozen transport stagger/backoff (hash-derived, deterministic). Per-tuple budgets (3/5/6) are class-based and uniform across arms/samples.
Only run-progress-mutable state is the persistent budget ledger; its only failure mode is BUDGET_HARD_CAP_EXCEEDED (invalid-run stop), which cannot produce an empty HTTP 200 response.
Run dir uses wx-exclusive writes; retries keep independent attempt files; terminal marker written last; no overwrite path exists for accepted tuples.

Frozen V2.4 backoff (2s/5s/15s/30s/60s + stagger) is applied ONLY to transport-class retries. EMPTY_CONTENT retries (kind parse) are re-fired immediately with no delay/jitter (observed inter-attempt gaps ~2.1-2.7s = context rebuild + provider round trip, not backoff). This is a scheduling property of the frozen policy, not a request/state defect; it is relevant to retry-policy design (see execution-only-rerun-policy-proposal).

evidence: 22/22 stored serialized_request_sha256 values reproduced byte-exact by offline reconstruction using the frozen executor builders (V2.2/V2.4/V3-R1; A3 targets incl. 711 and controls)
independent audit re-rendered A3/tt15-006 5 times -> identical sha 03b12ee6100231e3..., 9282 bytes, route DECIDE, evidence [ev001, ev002]
request body contains no tuple_index/attempt/progress field (prompt-renderer.mjs:87-108)

tuple_index_dependence.details: No executor state depends on call index/run progress in a way that could alter model-visible request bytes or provider acquisition. Execution order runs tuple 711 at order position 284; failure follows tuple identity, not loop position.

verdict.summary: No executor state/index/order defect. Provider-visible requests are byte-deterministic functions of (fixture sample, arm, frozen prompts, frozen parameters), verified by 22/22 byte-exact offline reconstructions and an independent 68-file audit. EMPTY_CONTENT responses therefore originate provider-side on the given frozen request content; the only executor-side property of interest is the absence of backoff between EMPTY_CONTENT retries (frozen policy; proposal in execution-only-rerun-policy-proposal.md).
